#scStats
##bimodal distribution
```{r}
Pulse:"#377EB8"
Minus:"#A50F15"
gDNA_reads <- read.csv("/media/erlantz/71DE167A75E99BB4/combinatorial_indexing_chapter/Run2_ESC_MEFs/Stats_counts/stats_combi_run2_ESC.csv", sep = ",", header = T)

gDNA_ano <- read.csv("/media/erlantz/71DE167A75E99BB4/combinatorial_indexing_chapter/Run2_ESC_MEFs/Stats_counts/plus_dox_minus_dox_annotated.csv", sep = "\t")
ggplot(gDNA_ano, aes(x = log10(readcount), fill = Condition)) +
  geom_histogram(position = "identity", alpha = 0.6, bins = 50, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("24h_Dox" = "#00441B", "Minus_Dox" = "#000000")) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of raw reads by Condition",
    x = "log10(Annotated Reads)",
    y = "Count",
    fill = "Dox"
  ) +
 theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "plain"),
    plot.title = element_text(size =11, face = "plain", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11, angle = 45, face = "plain", hjust = 1),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "plain"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black", size = 0.5),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "plain", size = 11),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    legend.key.size = unit(0.2, "cm"),   # overall size
    legend.key.width = unit(0.2, "cm"),  # width
    legend.key.height = unit(0.2, "cm"))+
    guides(fill= guide_legend(nrow = 2))
ggsave("/media/erlantz/71DE167A75E99BB4/combinatorial_indexing_chapter/Run2_ESC_MEFs/Stats_counts/bimodal_distribution_histogram_combi_plus_minus_annotated.png", dpi=300, width = 5, height = 3)

gDNA_ano_plus <- gDNA_ano[gDNA_ano$Condition == "24h_Dox",]
d <- density(log10(gDNA_ano_plus$readcount), na.rm = TRUE)
y <- d$y
x <- d$x

# Find where slope changes from decreasing to increasing (i.e., local minima)
valley_indices <- which(diff(sign(diff(y))) == 2) + 1

# Get valleys around x ≈ 3.5 to 4.5 (just before the second peak)
target_valleys <- valley_indices[x[valley_indices] > 3.5 & x[valley_indices] < 4.5]

# Extract the most likely valley
cutoff_point <- x[target_valleys[which.min(y[target_valleys])]]
print(paste("Cutoff at local minimum:", round(cutoff_point, 3)))

cutoff_index <- target_valleys[which.min(y[target_valleys])]
cutoff_x <- x[cutoff_index]
cutoff_y <- y[cutoff_index]

# Plot
ggplot(data = data.frame(x = x, y = y), aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_line(color = "#377EB8", size = 1.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = cutoff_x, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", size = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(x = cutoff_x, y = cutoff_y), color = "red", size = 3) +
  annotate("text", x = cutoff_x, y = cutoff_y + 0.0005,
           label = paste0("Cutoff ≈ ", round(cutoff_x, 2)),
           color = "red", vjust = -2, hjust = -0.50, size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "24h Dox",
    x = "log10(Annotated Reads)",
    y = "Density"
  ) +
   theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "plain"),
    plot.title = element_text(size =11, face = "plain", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11, angle = 0, face = "plain", hjust = 1),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "plain"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black", size = 0.5),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "plain", size = 11),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    legend.key.size = unit(0.2, "cm"),   # overall size
    legend.key.width = unit(0.2, "cm"),  # width
    legend.key.height = unit(0.2, "cm"))+
    guides(fill= guide_legend(nrow = 2))
ggsave("/media/erlantz/71DE167A75E99BB4/combinatorial_indexing_chapter/Run2_ESC_MEFs/Stats_counts/local_minima_histogram_combi_plus_v2.png", dpi=300, width = 3, height = 2)
ggsave("/media/erlantz/71DE167A75E99BB4/Thesis/chapter_2/Plots/Figure1/illustrator/local_minima_histogram_combi_plus_v2.svg", dpi=300, width = 3, height = 2)
ggsave("/media/erlantz/71DE167A75E99BB4/Thesis/chapter_2/Plots/Figure1/illustrator/local_minima_histogram_combi_plus_v2.pdf", dpi=300, width = 3, height = 2)
```

```{r}
combi_run5_collision <- read.csv("/media/erlantz/Erlantz/Run2_CI/Collision_rate/CI_whole_plotting_collision.csv", header = T, sep = "\t")


combi_run5_collision <- combi_run5_collision %>%
  mutate(species = case_when(
    mouse_useful > 0.25 & human_useful > 0.25 ~ "collision",
    mouse_useful > 0.25 & human_useful <= 0.25 ~ "Mouse",
    mouse_useful <= 0.25 & human_useful > 0.25 ~ "Human",
    mouse_useful <= 0.25 & human_useful <= 0.25 ~ "None"
  ))
ggplot(combi_run5_collision, aes(x = log10(All_reads), fill = species)) +
  geom_histogram(position = "identity", alpha = 0.6, bins = 50, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Mouse" = "#00441B", "Human" = "#000000","Collision" = "#999999", "NA" = "red")) +

    y = "Count",

  theme(

    legend.key.height = unit(0.2, "cm"))+
    guides(fill= guide_legend(nrow = 2))
############Mouse##########
gDNA_ano_mouse <- combi_run5_collision[combi_run5_collision$species == "Mouse",]
d <- density(log10(gDNA_ano_mouse$All_reads), na.rm = TRUE)
y <- d$y
x <- d$x

# Find where slope changes from decreasing to increasing (i.e., local minima)
valley_indices <- which(diff(sign(diff(y))) == 2) + 1

# Get valleys around x ≈ 3.5 to 4.5 (just before the second peak)
target_valleys <- valley_indices[x[valley_indices] > 3 & x[valley_indices] < 4.5]

# Extract the most likely valley
cutoff_point <- x[target_valleys[which.min(y[target_valleys])]]
print(paste("Cutoff at local minimum:", round(cutoff_point, 3)))

cutoff_index <- target_valleys[which.min(y[target_valleys])]
cutoff_x <- x[cutoff_index]
cutoff_y <- y[cutoff_index]

# Plot
ggplot(data = data.frame(x = x, y = y), aes(x = x, y = y)) +
  geom_line(color = "#00441B", size = 1.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = cutoff_x, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", size = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(x = cutoff_x, y = cutoff_y), color = "red", size = 3) +
  annotate("text", x = cutoff_x, y = cutoff_y + 0.0005,
           label = paste0("Cutoff ≈ ", round(cutoff_x, 2)),
           color = "red", vjust = -2, hjust = -0.50, size = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "Density of log10(Annotated Reads) with Local Minimum Mouse",
    x = "log10(Annotated Reads)",
    y = "Density"
  ) +
   theme(strip.background = element_blank(), strip.text = element_text(size=8, face="bold"), plot.title = element_text(size=8, face="bold",hjust = 0.5), axis.text=element_text(size=8, angle = 45, face="bold", colour = "black", hjust = 1),
        axis.title=element_text(size=8,face="bold"),panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_blank(), axis.line = element_line(colour = "black", size = 1.2),legend.text = element_text(size=8), legend.title = element_text(face="bold",size=8))
ggsave("/media/erlantz/71DE167A75E99BB4/combinatorial_indexing_chapter/Run2_ESC_MEFs/collision/local_minima_histogram_combi_mouse.png", dpi=300, width = 5, height = 3)
############HUMAN
gDNA_ano_human <- combi_run5_collision[combi_run5_collision$species == "Human",]
```

#Motif Analysis
##No minus dox background
```{r}
motifs <- read.delim("/media/erlantz/71DE167A75E99BB4/combinatorial_indexing_chapter/Run2_ESC_MEFs/MACS2_peaks/Homer_motif_enhancers_minusbg/knownResults.txt", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

colnames(motifs) <- c("Motif_Name","Motif_Name2","Tool","Consensus","P.value","Log_P.value","q.value","Target.Sequences.with.Motif.of.70","Target.Sequences.with.Motif","Background.Sequences.with.Motif.of.45757","Background.Sequences.with.Motif")
# Optional: simplify and filter
library(dplyr)
highlight_TFs <- c("Nanog", "Sox2", "Oct4", "Klf4", "NANOG","SOX2","KLF4","MYC")
pattern <- paste(highlight_TFs, collapse = "|") 
top_motifs <- motifs %>%
  dplyr::select(Motif_Name, P.value, Log_P.value, q.value, Consensus,Target.Sequences.with.Motif) %>%
  arrange(q.value) %>%
  slice_head(n = 100) %>%
  mutate(
    Highlight = ifelse(grepl(pattern, Motif_Name, ignore.case = TRUE), "Pluripotency TFs", "Other"),
    Display.Label = ifelse(Highlight == "Pluripotency TFs",Motif_Name, "")  # only label selected
  )


top_motifs2 <- top_motifs[top_motifs$Log_P.value < -1.3,]
# Plot
ggplot(top_motifs2, aes(x =  reorder(Motif_Name, Log_P.value), y = Log_P.value, fill = Highlight)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = top_motifs2$Display.Label) +  # selectively show labels
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Pluripotency TFs" = "#e31a1c", "Other" = "#a6cee3")) +
  labs(
    title = "Motif Enrichment",
```
